notes: v1.10.7 - Reconnect: a Reconnect button while a world is down (or .reconnect) connects again in the same tab, scrollback and all; double-clicking a character whose tab is open goes to that tab instead of opening a second one, using the profile as it is now; and a server that drops the connection straight away no longer resets the retry budget. A prompt sent without a newline or GA now shows after a short pause, so triggers and auto-login see it at once. Safer: an error in the window is logged and shown instead of closing Scrye; Delete in the MUD list and Remove for a plugin ask for a second press; macros no longer fire while you type in other text boxes; Esc closes Settings, the profile editor and Quick Connect; TLS no longer accepts any certificate unless 'Accept self-signed' is ticked; a log that cannot be written stops itself instead of stopping the display; a malformed GMCP message can no longer swallow game output; a trigger or alias pattern that takes over 250 ms is skipped and named. Plugins: Lua plugins get a 256 MB memory limit, a failing plugin prints a few errors a minute instead of one per line, and one failing 30 times a minute is unloaded. Macros: the numpad's + - *…
